artifact_schema.description: The discrete logarithm k, as 131 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

k.description: k with k*G = Q, in [1, n), zero-padded to exactly 131 lowercase hexadecimal digits.

statement: Find the discrete logarithm k for the NIST P-521 curve: k*G = Q. The checker pins the NIST SP 800-186 domain parameters and derives Q by trying x-coordinates from SHAKE256(seed || counter), selecting the first curve point and choosing its y parity from the digest. The seed is cairn/nist-prime-curve-dlog/p521/v1. This deterministic construction does not choose k. Submit k in [1,n), as exactly 131 lowercase hexadecimal digits. The order n is prime and the curve cofactor is 1, so the answer is unique in this range. The derived target is Q=(03f9b2f465e354af0ea5ba47947000186c5867ba4c581f87c99b9f3a8cfd9f1abbe32eed834cb8f21f5ae6fc335c4ee7ac966709bcf96726ceaf0ed631daa158a44, 0efe497191b3a89c61be30458706fb1879a4fb68bc36126c3e1f5aef71638cf075b0155d7bbcd4ab1bfb6bd0882233bbc0febe735a6829cfc5ef304c6e762ee8969); the first valid counter is 0.
